items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Brother Conrad wasn't there, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no. It was Albert Burbank, Jack Willis, Frog Joseph.

ctx.x: Favourite musicians are Manuel Paul, for one, I don't know what you're just talking about. Captain Handy. George. Lewis. Jim. I like Lewis Nelson very much. I like Jim better. Dee Dee knocked me right out the night I heard Dee Dee. I've only heard him once, but that was tremendous. And Billy, of course, was good. She didn't play on the night, but she sang. And they did a couple of duets, which were really tremendous. I like Kid Thomas. I like Chester's artist very much. And Dre, I've only heard a couple of times,…

No, no. It was Albert Burbank, Jack Willis, Frog Joseph. Jeanette Kimball played piano. She's good, too. And some fellow called Frank on bass. Frank's somebody or other on bass. Fields, Frank Fields. And Louis Barberin on drums. But who else is there? Well, I like Frank Moyet very much, the piano player. And Charlie Hamilton's also a good pianist. Who else is there?
